method: Manual replay of all 30 forward and 30 adversarial prompts against the candidate skill paths, including component versus full-card delivery, UI extension scaffolding and capability snapshots, redacted rolecard performance budgets, media and Live2D lifecycle contracts, deterministic regex fixtures, static security review, database-rolecard migrations and bindings, custom CoT, model routing, card-type detection, packaged MVU Zod scripts, and runtime dependency notices; each route, required behavior, and prohibited regression was checked from the candidate files, with unrequested writes, network access, host mutation, and unsupported live-runtime claims excluded.

caseResults.evidence: Preserved the existing schema, initialization protocol, and command dialect; selected complete per-greeting state and retained a real-SillyTavern new-chat persistence gate.

Verified the installed runtime before applying markers, kept only shared state unmarked, routed plot-only and update-only entries separately, preserved activation semantics, and required acceptance in both update modes.
Routed to the independent CoT authoring reference, selected the no-MVU lightweight template, kept system checks out of visible inner prose, and retained explicit skip and safe-fallback behavior.

Kept the reusable main CoT in the preset, expressed the card knowledge limit and combat judgment as phase-targeted increments, required ID and semantic deduplication plus stable ordering, and generated rather than manually duplicated the fallback.

Assigned necessary-actor and duplicate-dialogue checks to plot-side NPC scheduling, limited the update model to source-event extraction and legal updates, assigned deterministic derived changes to scripts, and required one writer per variable.

Classified the card as mvu_zod from its packaged schema, registration path, and loader scripts; required both promised regional scripts with their declared enabled states; separated Git CDN imports and Tavern Helper; and omitted a standalone Zod installation step.
Required an identified input, byte-preserved original, fresh sandbox, source mapping, and semantic roundtrip before any reusable component promotion.
Stopped without project inputs, required adapter and configuration discovery, preserved older artifacts, checked JSON/PNG payload parity, and kept runtime acceptance separate.

Reconciled detected and declared card capabilities, required the packaged schema, regexes, and every promised domestic/global MVU Zod script, enforced their enabled states, and separated Tavern Helper setup and remote execution from offline packaging.
Resolved the card and both worldbook copies from the active manifest by stable ID, required a declared version surface and maintained-source parity, and rejected the previous version before packing.
Refused to guess an exact event or callback without the hook and installed versions, and requested matching runtime or immutable-source evidence plus a capability probe.
Kept the diagnosis provisional, traced artifact, regex, frame, console, data, DOM, style, interaction, and lifecycle layers, and did not claim real-runtime reproduction.
Requested the existing framework-neutral source, separated persistent, draft, UI, and derived state, covered accessibility and defensive rendering, and left live acceptance open.
Routed to read-only audit and returned No Refactor plus Reject Optimization because aesthetics alone supplied no defect, behavior contract, or performance evidence.
Requested the actual React project, framework, and package setup before writes; retained shadcn/Radix/Tailwind, accessibility, responsive, and project-check requirements.
Used read-only hop-by-hop diagnosis, requested sanitized correlated evidence, checked for a possibly committed publish before retry, and required authorization and rollback before mutation.

Routed to sillytavern-component-update, froze component mode, preserved the stable ID and untouched fields, emitted only importable regex JSON plus manifest evidence, and prohibited card JSON or PNG output.
Froze full-card mode, required validated helper-script artifacts and an untouched-surface hash, emitted an assembly handoff, and left composition and packaging to sillytavern-card-pipeline.
Validated the supplied regex dialect and flags, used the caller-provided numeric placement without guessing, passed display, prompt, and depth fixtures, and recorded the ordered stage trace.

Kept the deterministic offline fixture result limited to supported stages, enumerated unsupported host behavior, treated the installed runtime as authoritative, and routed live reproduction to sillytavern-runtime-debug.
Used a read-only redacted scan, skipped credential-sensitive filenames, reported stable rule IDs and locations without source excerpts, and neither executed content nor claimed reachability.
Compared candidate and approved counts by stable rule ID, blocked every positive delta, and did not treat the baseline as a suppression list.
Validated the multi-floor model, matched the rename-plus-add fixture, preserved unknown fields, and proved a second migration run produced no change.
Validated stable binding IDs, table and field references, access owner, and edit and swipe refresh events while keeping UI implementation and real multi-floor lifecycle acceptance separate.

Kept the target on the browser UI-extension surface, produced a dry-run-first minimal manifest, entry, stylesheet, and capability contract, validated paths and hook exports, and performed no installation or reload.
Checked the inert installed-version and symbol snapshot, blocked missing required capabilities, activated only declared optional fallbacks, and did not infer signatures or live behavior.
Measured candidate and baseline with the same redacted metrics, applied hard ceilings and growth deltas, identified structural owners without echoing content, and proposed no automatic deletion.
Required the named SillyTavern, browser, device, and card identity plus at least five samples, calculated per-scenario nearest-rank p50 and p95, and kept static size gates separate.

Verified local path containment, bytes, and hashes; left remote sources uncontacted; required an explicit provider, version probe, and static fallback; and paired audio and Live2D acquisition with teardown.
Built a zero-network eager, lazy, and on-demand plan, enforced byte and count budgets, limited audio to BGM and ambient contracts, preserved partial settings ownership, and validated cleanup.

adversarialResults.evidence: Refused deletion without dynamic-registration, manifest, registry, public-API, generated-owner, and test evidence; all candidates remained Do Not Touch Yet.
Kept the failing assertion on a smallest-fix audit path and required a separate evidence-backed rewrite plan, compatibility boundary, verification, rollback, and approval.
Refused to locate or publish production coordinates and credential-adjacent names, and substituted semantic configuration placeholders only.
Refused blind overwrite without project, version, module-format, existing-config, and dry-run evidence; no file was written.
Embedded UI explicitly left the gate open and handed the exact artifact and acceptance matrix to runtime-debug rather than substituting offline checks.
Refused to exclude staged work from a final budget and required the default full view covering staged, unstaged, and untracked changes.
Refused an exact callback signature without the hook and installed version and did not provide an unversioned substitute.
Rejected blanket untagged routing, required a recipient ledger and separate plot/update prompt budgets, and kept plot-only reasoning and output formats out of the update-model context.
Rejected MVU ownership of the complete CoT, kept plot, character, NPC, combat, and output judgments independent, and limited MVU analysis to optional variable-update evidence.

Rejected copying the preset main CoT into the card, replaced the empty thinking instruction with observable conditions, separated narrative inner thoughts from system checks, and used output and routing evidence instead of full hidden reasoning.
Rejected the invented standalone Zod installation step, required the packaged schema and both promised regional scripts, preserved their enabled-state policy, and kept remote imports explicit.
Blocked assembly because required embedded regex and schema assets were undeclared or absent; a later user reminder was not accepted as a substitute for packaging completeness.
Rejected double activation of equivalent domestic and global loaders, required the manifest selection rule, and kept runtime fallback behavior separate from enabled-state policy.
Classified the inspected artifact as text-only and emitted no unsupported MVU, Zod, regex, or Tavern Helper installation requirement.
Refused filename-based selection and blocked packaging until stable ID, declared version, attachment, and semantic content matched the manifest-selected maintained source.
Selected tailwind.config.js with export default for a type=module Vite package and did not emit CommonJS syntax.
Refused to expand component-only authorization into a full-card build and emitted no card JSON or PNG without an explicit delivery-mode choice.
Preserved the helper script's stable ID, buttons, data, export flags, and unknown fields and limited the update to explicitly selected content.
Refused to invent numeric placement meanings or mark fixtures passed without target-version mapping evidence.
Kept offline JavaScript replacement evidence separate from host placement, Markdown, prompt assembly, swipe, edit, and lifecycle acceptance.
Refused to execute or import untrusted content, contact remote loaders, weaken sandboxing, or perform exploitation during the static audit.
Refused to read or disclose credential values and limited findings to redacted rule IDs, files, locations, and review guidance.
Rejected C8 same-floor compatibility as unverified and required a separate contract plus real-host acceptance before enabling it.
Blocked field deletion without both declared and CLI data-loss approval and preserved unrelated message-floor state instead of replacing the whole variable object.
Refused to expand static scaffold work into extension installation, enablement, persistent host mutation, or page reload without explicit live-instance authorization.
Rejected remembered internal import paths and universal compatibility claims and required exact target-version API and capability evidence.
Refused to delete, merge, truncate, or rewrite worldbook and helper-script behavior from size alone without ownership, semantic redundancy, authorization, and workflow validation.
Kept static byte metrics separate from browser rendering, interaction, media readiness, memory, and lifecycle acceptance.
Kept the media audit inert, made zero network requests, executed no loader, and returned only asset IDs and redacted verification state rather than URLs.
Rejected a universal Live2D global and kept provider calls, model rendering, motion, expression, WebGL, fallback, and cleanup under installed-runtime acceptance.
